hypothesis: A clean Actions runner exposes hidden local-state assumptions that a warm checkout misses.
return_commit_id_note: Assigned when this document is committed and reported in the producer READY_TO_COMMIT terminal report. Its tree contains all five required artifacts.
limitations: L-01: Behaviour observed on a real GitHub-hosted Actions runner — NOT_SUPPORTED. Dispatching a workflow run would mutate the repository's CI surface and would require creating or modifying a pull request. Both are explicitly forbidden to this unit.

L-02: Read-time byte counts and digests for the two github/docs Markdown sources — NOT_SUPPORTED. Those two files were read for their verbatim claim text and their transfer digests were not captured at the moment of reading.

L-03: The model that actually executed this attempt — PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED. The immutable input requests configuration.model_slug claude-opus-5-thinking-high with auto_model_selection false. The provider exposes no per-subagent model field, and the enclosing run reports gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast.
L-04: Independent acceptance of this result — NOT_SUPPORTED. A producer cannot accept its own result, and only the coordinator may record COMPLETED.
L-05: Windows and macOS runners — scope exclusion. All reproductions ran on Linux. Path semantics, the default shell and the filesystem differ enough that extrapolating would be invention.

L-06: Self-hosted runners and GitHub Enterprise Server — scope exclusion. A self-hosted runner can reuse a workspace between jobs, which would change the conclusions materially: the bytecode contamination that a hosted runner discards would persist exactly as it does in the warm checkout.

L-07: The runner image inventory — scope exclusion. actions/runner-images was not consulted. Preinstalled-software questions were outside this unit's hypotheses and would have added unverified breadth.
L-08: Practitioner sources — scope exclusion. No blog, forum thread or social post was admitted as evidence. Every claim rests on an immutable upstream commit or an immutable repository digest.

L-09: The differential harness only speaks about paths a probe exercises — instrument limitation. Twenty-four probes cover the two declared CI commands, the protocol's provenance checks, custody read-back, environment portability and interpreter availability. A hidden dependence in an unprobed path would not be found.

L-10: AGREE does not mean clean — instrument limitation. Seventeen of twenty-four probes agree across all three environments, and the unit's single most consequential finding is among them. A reader who treats the classification counts as a defect tally will draw the wrong conclusion.

L-11: The warm mode is not reproducible by construction — instrument limitation. Warm-mode results depend on the invoking host's environment and existing tree, so probes p18, p19 and p20 would give different answers elsewhere.

L-12: The static control's R1 rule counts this unit's own documentation — instrument limitation. Four files inside this unit quote the defective identifier in order to document or test it: harness/probes.json, sources/source-claims.json, proposals/mechanism-changes.json and the MC-02 patch. They appear among the 69 PREFIX_ONLY_CORRECT findings.

L-13: The workflow parser is a minimal YAML subset, not a YAML implementation — instrument limitation. The static control parses workflow files with a purpose-built subset parser, because the reproduction must run with no third-party package.

L-14: The mechanism verifier proves a patch works, not that it should be applied — instrument limitation. All 43 checks passing establishes that each change removes its defect without breaking the seeded suite or the taxonomy check. It does not establish that the coordinator should accept the cost.

L-15: An earlier revision of this unit's own reproduction script carried the defect class it studies — self-inflicted, detected and fixed. run.sh accepted a relative --out and passed it to stages that run with the clean clone as their working directory, so the JSON reports were written into the clone. They were discarded with it, and the writes dirtied the tree the probes measure, flipping four cleanliness gates from AGREE to CLEAN_ONLY_PASS.
Producer self-verification only. independent_acceptance is NOT_TESTED: the producer does not accept its own result, and no COMPLETED or ACCEPTED state is claimed.
This document's own SHA-256 and byte count cannot appear inside itself. They are reported in the producer terminal report and are recomputable from the immutable commit tree.
